description: The ARIA role a native element has by default: `<button>` is `button`, `<h2>` is `heading` level 2, `<input type="checkbox">` is `checkbox`.
What assistive technologies announce for an element, computed from `aria-labelledby`, `aria-label`, `<label>`, `alt`, text content or `title`. Matched by the `name` query option.
`getBy` throws when missing, `queryBy` returns `null` (for absence checks), `findBy` returns a Promise that waits for the element.
Scopes queries to a container element: `within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'OK' })`.
A live region that screen readers announce immediately when its content appears. Use it for errors.
